name: Taralga Wind Farm
notable: 107 MW, 51 Vestas V90-2.0 MW turbines near Taralga in NSW Southern Tablelands. Developed by CBD Energy, now owned by Energy Pacific (Marubeni subsidiary).

timeline.title: Land & Environment Court determination
timeline.detail: Approval upheld after appeal to NSW L&E Court

timeline.title: Construction commenced
timeline.detail: Approval for works; modified to 51 turbines with larger capacity

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Taralga Wind Farm — other source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.turbine_model: Vestas V90 (21x V90-2MW + 8x V90-3MW) + Vestas V100-1.8 MW (22)
eis_specs.notes: Regime: other. DA-241/04 lodged with Upper Lachlan Council Nov 2004; consent granted 24 Feb 2007. Multiple modifications since. CBD Energy/Banco Santander initial owner; Repositioned to Energy Pacific/CBUS/Palisade. Commissioned 2015; 106.8 MW.
